description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Somberwald Beastmaster, adding {C}{C}.
Somberwald Beastmaster dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Somberwald Beastmaster from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Somberwald Beastmaster enters the battlefield, creating a 2/2 Wolf, a 3/3 Beast and a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
